name: Almighty Insane Popes Nation
description: The Almighty Insane Popes Nation is a predominantly European-American street gang formed in the late 1950s on Chicago's North Side, originating from a Greek greaser group at Lawrence and Rockwell who had conflicts with the Latin Kings. Rather than joining the Simon City Royals, they formed their own gang under the Folk Nation alliance, with the name standing for 'Protecting Our People Eliminating Scum.' At their peak in the mid-1960s to early 1970s they had an estimated 300–500 members, drawn primarily from Polish, German, Irish, and Scandinavian communities in Albany Park, Portage Park, and Jefferson Park. They remain closely allied with the Simon City Royals and Imperial Gangsters.
